description: Match a scientific name against the GBIF backbone taxonomy. Returns the best-matching taxon with full classification and a confidence score (0–100). This is the mandatory first step for any GBIF workflow — it returns the backbone taxonKey required by gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, and gbif_occurrence_facets. When the name GBIF matched is a synonym — the queried name, or the higher taxon a HIGHERRANK match falls back to — taxonKey is the accepted taxon it resolves to and matchedTaxonKey carries the synonym's own key; occurrence counts differ sharply between the two, so pass taxonKey. acceptedName names that accepted taxon whenever GBIF's answer does. matchType HIGHERRANK is GBIF's label for a match made at a higher rank: a misspelled or unknown species falls back to its genus or even its kingdom, at a confidence that can exceed 90, and a bare genus name carries the label too, matched as that genus. taxonKey then covers that whole taxon, or its accepted taxon when it is a synonym, and a notice names it. Below confidence 80, the match should be reviewed. matchType NONE means no usable match was found — try removing the strict flag or broadening the name; when GBIF reports several equal matches, as for a genus name shared by an animal and a plant, set kingdom to pick one. GBIF no longer updates the backbone, so a name described or revised since its last build falls back to a higher taxon there; checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b matches against the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release instead, GBIF's current taxonomy, and returns its keys as strings in checklistTaxonKey and checklistMatchedTaxonKey with no taxonKey or rank keys — they are not backbone keys, and no tool that takes a numeric taxonKey can use them, but gbif_search_occurrences, gbif_count_occurrences, and gbif_occurrence_facets take checklistTaxonKey under that name, with checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b.

checklistKey.description: Taxonomy to match against. Omitted, or d7dddbf4-2cf0-4f39-9b2a-bb099caae36c, is the GBIF Backbone, whose integer keys the occurrence and species tools take; GBIF no longer updates it. 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b is the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release, the taxonomy GBIF now maintains, where a recently described or revised name can match exactly; its keys come back as strings in checklistTaxonKey and checklistMatchedTaxonKey, and taxonKey, matchedTaxonKey, and the rank keys are absent.

kingdom.description: Narrow the match to a specific kingdom (e.g., "Animalia", "Plantae", "Fungi") to disambiguate names that appear in multiple kingdoms. Omit the field to match against the whole checklist — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the undisambiguated match, which is indistinguishable from a match that honored the kingdom.

name.description: Scientific name to match. Examples: "Parus major", "Agaricus bisporus", "Homo sapiens". Fuzzy matching handles minor spelling variations. Common names are not supported — use gbif_search_species for vernacular name searches.

rank.description: Expected taxonomic rank. Use to avoid matching a genus when you expect a species.

strict.description: When true, only return an exact match. When false (default), GBIF applies fuzzy matching — useful for minor spelling variations and abbreviated names.

name: gbif_match_species

acceptedName.description: Canonical name, without authorship, of the accepted taxon a synonym resolves to. Present only on a synonym match whose answer names that taxon: under the backbone it is read from the classification field whose key equals taxonKey, so it is absent when the accepted taxon is below species rank (call gbif_get_species with taxonKey for it); under the Catalogue of Life every synonym carries it.

checklistMatchedTaxonKey.description: Catalogue of Life key of the name that actually matched. Present only when it differs from checklistTaxonKey — that is, when a synonym was resolved to its accepted taxon.

checklistTaxonKey.description: Catalogue of Life key of the accepted taxon (or of the matched taxon when it is not a synonym), a case-sensitive string such as TPJ7G. Present only when checklistKey selects the Catalogue of Life. Not a backbone key: a digit-only one such as 8288 names an unrelated backbone taxon, so never pass it where a numeric taxonKey is asked for. The occurrence tools take it as checklistTaxonKey, with checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b.

classKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the class. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

confidence.description: Match confidence score 0–100. Below 80 warrants review. A HIGHERRANK match can score above 90, so read matchType too.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: matchType is NONE — no candidate met the match threshold, or several equal candidates tied; the message then carries GBIF's note. `invalid_filter`: kingdom was supplied blank or whitespace-only, which disambiguates nothing. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

familyKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the family. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

genusKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the genus. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

kingdomKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the kingdom. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

matchType.description: EXACT, FUZZY, HIGHERRANK, or NONE; under the Catalogue of Life, VARIANT takes the place of FUZZY for a variant spelling or authorship. HIGHERRANK means GBIF matched at a higher rank — a misspelled species falls back to its genus or kingdom, and a bare genus name carries it too — and the key covers that whole taxon, or its accepted taxon when it is a synonym. NONE means no usable match.

matchedTaxonKey.description: Backbone key of the name that actually matched. Present only when it differs from taxonKey — that is, when a synonym was resolved to its accepted taxon.

notice.description: Guidance when matchType is HIGHERRANK — naming the taxon and rank GBIF matched and what the key covers — or when the matched name was a synonym and the key was resolved to the accepted taxon. A higher-rank match on a synonym carries both. Absent on any other match of an accepted name.

orderKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the order. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

phylumKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the phylum. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the matched taxon.

species.description: Species canonical name of the matched taxon.

speciesKey.description: Backbone taxon key for the species. Absent under the Catalogue of Life.

status.description: Taxonomic status of the matched name: ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, or DOUBTFUL, and under the Catalogue of Life also PROVISIONALLY_ACCEPTED.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key to pass to downstream tools. The accepted taxon's key when the name GBIF matched is a synonym, otherwise the matched taxon's own key. Absent under the Catalogue of Life, whose key is checklistTaxonKey.

title: Match Species Name
